text: 9月20日，国家药监局副局长杨胜在国新办发布会上表示，将支持医药产业规模化、集约化、高端化发展。鼓励医药企业建设智能工厂、绿色工厂，将继续支持京津冀、长三角、粤港澳大湾区、成渝双城经济圈等区域医药产业发展，着力培养3-5个具有国际竞争力的生物医药产业创新聚集地。将支持医药领域扩大对外开放合作，鼓励外资将原研药品和高端医疗装备引进境内生产，也鼓励中国企业走出去发展，让中国的药品器械造福全世界。
text_en: On September 20, Yang Sheng, Vice Administrator of the National Medical Products Administration, said at a State Council Information Office press conference that support will be given to the pharmaceutical industry's development toward scale, concentration and high-end orientation. Pharmaceutical companies will be encouraged to build smart factories and green factories, continued support will be given to pharmaceutical industry development in regions such as the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the Yangtze River Delta, the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area and the Chengdu-Chongqing economic circle, and efforts will focus on cultivating 3-5 biopharmaceutical innovation clusters with international competitiveness. Support will be given to expanding opening-up and cooperation in the pharmaceutical sector, foreign investment will be encouraged to bring original research drugs and high-end medical equipment into China for production, and Chinese companies will also be encouraged to go global so that Chinese drugs and medical devices can benefit the world.
